node.title: Re^4: Is it possible to modify __DATA__ via the DATA file handle or otherwise?
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
Still using the [DOC://tell|tell] of the DATA filehandle is the far better approach.

There is no guaranty to correctly match __DATA__ without having a full Perl parser.
